title: CDDRL Pre-doctoral and Postdoctoral Fellowships
institution: Center on Democracy, Development and the Rule of Law, Stanford University
about: Nine-month residential fellowships (September to June) at Stanford supporting writing and research in residence for pre-doctoral and postdoctoral scholars; CDDRL offers 2-4 fully funded fellowships each academic year.
requirements: Pre-doctoral: enrolled in a doctoral program and at the dissertation write-up stage, through the residency period
Postdoctoral: PhD earned within three years of the fellowship start, or dissertation defense by July 31, 2027

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "research" (required skill) → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."
"academic writing" (required skill) → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."

"at the dissertation write-up stage" (pre-doctoral requirement) → "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."
